provenance.source: The expected values were worked out by hand from the published formulas (see formulas.ts) and the syllable counting in statistics.ts. Rebilly's Lexi (https://github.com/Rebilly/lexi) has no real expected scores to reuse.
provenance.howToRegenerate: Run ../tools/derive-expected.mjs. It does not call the code under test, and its output matches every value below.

fixtureTextProvenance.wikipedia-non-euclidean.txt: One paragraph copied from Lexi's test-data (MIT license), commit 963486e671c11353b0a31c0a132b28a4c129ddbc. It is an excerpt of the Simple English Wikipedia article 'Non-Euclidean geometry' (CC BY-SA). The markdown heading and link syntax were removed; the words are unchanged.
fixtureTextProvenance.committee-proposals.txt: Written for these tests. It has a different sentence and word mix and a non-trivial complexWords count.

provenance.toleranceNote: Scores are compared with a tolerance of 0.1. The stats are exact.
